description: Flags newly set up upcoming meetings without agenda, creates organizer draft emails, and sends Teams/email run summaries. NOTE : If JSON upload isn't supported, copy the JSON content and paste it into the Scout Cloud prompt to set up the automation.
name: Prompt to Set Agenda

steps.label: Collect Newly Setup Meetings
steps.prompt: Retrieve all non-cancelled meetings in the next 3 days with title, date/time, duration, attendees, organizer, and thread/context signals. Collect recency evidence from all available sources: (1) invite created timestamp, (2) invite received timestamp, (3) event/series last-modified timestamp, (4) matching meeting-message email timestamp from Sent or Received (Inbox) within the last 3 days, even when calendar fields are available. For email matching, first use normalized subject match (case-insensitive, trim prefixes like RE:/FW:). If subject is generic/ambiguous (for example: "Discussion", "Sync", "Catch-up"), allow fallback matching by organizer/from alignment plus meeting-time alignment (same date and approximate start time), and prefer evidence where body includes Teams/meeting metadata or time mention. For recurring meetings, collect series-level created/received/last-modified and meeting-message timestamps tied to series subject/thread. Do NOT exclude meetings due to RSVP state, response status, short notice, conflict indicators, or tentative status; those are non-filtering signals.

steps.label: Filter Meetings Without Agenda
steps.prompt: Keep only meetings that both (a) do not already have an agenda in invite/body/thread context and (b) have recency evidence within the last 3 days. Treat recency as satisfied if ANY one source is within 3 days: invite created, invite received, event/series last-modified, or a matching meeting-message email in Sent/Received (Inbox). Apply normalized subject matching (case-insensitive, ignore RE:/FW: prefixes), and for generic subjects also allow organizer+meeting-time fallback matching. Do not require all recency fields to exist. Exclude meetings with existing agendas and exclude older invitations/updates. Exclude recurring occurrences from long-standing series only when there is no qualifying series-level or instance-level recency evidence within 3 days. Do NOT exclude based on RSVP/response state, short-notice arrival, or conflict banners.

steps.label: Refine Agenda
steps.prompt: For each remaining meeting, prepare the organizer-request content for agenda collection, but DO NOT create or send any Outlook draft in this step. Carry forward the prepared wording to the next steps. This step is planning/content-only to avoid duplicate drafts.

steps.label: Ask to Attach Pre-Read
steps.prompt: For each remaining meeting, augment the prepared organizer-request content to include a pre-read request and the rule that any provided pre-read must be treated as the primary source for agenda generation. DO NOT create or send any Outlook draft in this step. This step is planning/content-only to avoid duplicate drafts.

steps.label: Create Organizer Drafts
steps.prompt: For each remaining meeting, create exactly one Outlook draft email to the organizer requesting both (a) agenda and (b) pre-read, including Meeting Title and meeting date/time. Enforce idempotency: before creating, check Drafts for an existing unsent draft that matches the same meeting (normalized subject, organizer, and meeting date/time context). If a matching draft already exists, do NOT create another; mark status as 'Existing draft reused'. If no matching draft exists (including cases where a prior draft was deleted), create a new draft and mark status as 'Draft created'. Do not send the email; save draft only. Output a per-meeting table with organizer, draft status, and draft subject (exclude Outlook draft IDs).

steps.label: Send Run Summary Notifications
steps.prompt: Send a concise run summary to both Teams and email. Teams: send one summary message of meetings processed, meetings excluded (agenda/old), and organizer drafts created. Email: create and send one summary email to the current user mailbox with the same counts and per-meeting draft status (exclude Outlook draft IDs from the summary).
